registry.preferred_name: Richter's transformation presenting as penile ulcer (transformation of chronic lymphocytic leukemia to diffuse large B-cell lymphoma)
support_spans: Biopsy of the glans penis ulcer showed dermal infiltrate of atypical lymphocytes, which were CD20+, CD79a+, and CD5+, within the background of a reactive T-cell infiltrate.
PCR analysis revealed a clonal IgH gene rearrangement.
PET-CT scan demonstrated FDG-avid abdominal and peripancreatic lymph nodes.
His medical history included an elevated white blood cell count and inguinal lymphadenopathy discovered 9 years prior.
